rateLimits.note: "Every IP address is allowed 15 requests in a 5s window"; a 429 answers beyond it, blocked requests count towards the quota: wait at least 5 s after a 429.

attribution.text: Moskovic, M. (2021). The INSPIRE REST API. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.5788550

provenance.notes: Read on 2026-11-10: the REST API documentation (15 requests per 5 s per IP; please cite Moskovic:2021zjs in scholarly work, a request) and the terms of use: most metadata under the CC0 waiver, except abstracts whose source is arXiv or CERN, author-supplied keywords and INSPIRE-schema keywords; downloading e-mail addresses is not permitted; reconstructing full texts from snippets is not allowed; the service is 'provided free of charge for educational and informational use' (commercial use not addressed: unknown). Redistribution left unknown because the abstracts this package reads may fall in the excluded fields. No rate-limit headers seen on a test call.
